title: Detroit Red Wings KIRK MALTBY Forever Collectable Bobblehead 2002 Stanley Cup
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Bobble Heads
descriptionText: The product is a Kirk Maltby Detroit Red Wings Forever Collectable Bobblehead from 2002 celebrating their Stanley Cup Championship. This officially licensed vintage bobblehead features the former player in his Detroit Red Wings uniform, making it a unique and nostalgic piece of sports memorabilia for fans of hockey and the team. Perfect for collectors or fans looking to add a special item to their memorabilia collection, this bobblehead is a timeless tribute to the team's championship victory in 2002.
